title: Horoscope match

note.bhakootSameLord: Both Moon signs have the same lord ({{lord}}); the points still count as 0.
note.nadiSameSign: Same Nadi. Both Moons are in the same sign with different birth stars; some panchangs (for example Drik Panchang) keep the 8 points here.

mangal.title: Mangal (Kuja) Dosha
mangal.separate: Checked separately; not part of the 36 points.
mangal.none: Mars is not in house 1, 4, 7, 8 or 12 from the ascendant or the Moon.
mangal.indeterminate: The ascendant can't be fixed without a birth time.
mangal.levelRule: High when Mars is in one of these houses from both the ascendant and the Moon; low when from one.

notice: A traditional calculation, shown as it is. It is not a prediction and not Mangalya's compatibility score; your family decides what it means.

warning.BIRTH_TIME_APPROXIMATE: Based on an approximate birth time.
warning.BIRTH_TIME_UNKNOWN: Birth time not known: only what holds for the whole day is used.

notDeterminable: The Guna Milan can't be worked out: a birth star changes during the time given. An exact birth time settles it.

missing.NO_CHART_SELF: Add your time and place of birth to see the horoscope match.
missing.NO_CHART_SELF_FAMILY: {{name}} hasn't added a time and place of birth yet.
missing.NO_CHART_OTHER: This person hasn't added a time and place of birth.
missing.NO_BIRTH_PLACE: Choose your place of birth from the list to see the horoscope match.

unavailable: The horoscope match couldn't be loaded. Try again shortly.

filter.title: Horoscope
filter.help: Uses both kundlis. People who have not added birth details are not shown while this is on.
filter.needChartTitle: The horoscope filter needs a kundli

porutham.essentialsAgree: Rajju and Vedha, the two traditionally treated as essential, both agree.
porutham.essentialsFail: Rajju or Vedha, traditionally treated as essential, does not agree.

basis.STREE_DEERGHA: Distance from the bride's star to the groom's

check.title: Kundli matching
check.intro: Enter two people’s birth details to see Guna Milan (36 gunas), Porutham (10 poruthams) and Mangal Dosha, worked out with the same rules as on profiles. A traditional calculation only, not a prediction.
check.incomplete: Add the date, place and time of birth (or choose “Don’t know the time”) for both.
check.invalid: One of the birth details can’t be used. Check the date and time, and choose the place from the list.
check.notSaved: Details entered here are not saved.
check.homeBody: Guna Milan and Porutham for any two people

details: How each one is worked out
